name: Return
formula: ReturnIndex_t / ReturnIndex_t-1 - 1
notes: EU: local currency; used by the return-based filters

name: Return_EUR
formula: ReturnIndex_EUR_t / ReturnIndex_EUR_t-1 - 1
notes: EU only; same row removals and delisting return as Return

name: BidAsk_Spread
formula: EDGE estimator (Ardia et al.) over 21 trading days; clipped to [0; 0.25]
notes: missing where OHLC is missing

name: IsFilled
formula: True if one of the forward-filled price columns was missing on that day
inputs: Open; High; Low; Close; ReturnIndex; AdjFactor; UnadjClose

name: DelistingReturnApplied
formula: True on the last observation of a delisted stock where the delisting return was compounded in
notes: delisting return -0.35 (own addition; not L&S)

name: size_group
formula: quintile of month-end market cap (1 = smallest)
inputs: MarketCAP (US: NYSE breakpoints); MarketCAP_EUR (EU: all European stocks)

name: size_group_country
formula: quintile of month-end MarketCAP_EUR within the country
notes: EU only

name: ret
formula: ReturnIndex at month end t / at month end t-1 - 1 (consecutive months only)
notes: contains the delisting return; EU: local currency

name: ret_eur
formula: ReturnIndex_EUR at month end t / at month end t-1 - 1 (consecutive months only)
notes: EU only

name: retx
formula: Close at month end t / at month end t-1 - 1 (consecutive months only)
notes: price return without dividends

name: bm
formula: common equity / firm market value (line market cap x firm_mcap_factor)
inputs: WC03501 (thousands); MarketCAP x 1000 (millions); EU euro countries: MarketCAP_EUR x 1000; firm_mcap_factor
notes: point in time (availability lag); firm level for multi-class firms; line market cap where no company id

name: ep
formula: net income / firm market value (same as bm)
inputs: WC01751; same market value as bm
notes: same market value as bm; replaces Datastream PE (ep = 1/PE but point in time and defined for losses)

name: bm_line
formula: common equity / market cap of the line
notes: before the share-class correction; for checks (42_check_bm_consistency.py)

name: firm_id
formula: Worldscope company id of the line
notes: same for all share classes of a firm; current value, not point in time

name: firm_mcap_factor
formula: sum of market caps of the firm's lines in the month / market cap of the line
notes: only lines in the filtered universe, one line per ISIN; 1 without firm_id

name: firm_n_lines
formula: number of lines (ISINs) of the firm in the universe in the month

name: dy_12m
formula: sum of the last 12 monthly dividend returns (ret - retx; clipped at 0)
notes: requires 12 consecutive monthly returns; replaces Datastream DY

name: <var>_prev
formula: value of the latest earlier report at least 9 months older (normally the previous fiscal year)
notes: readable name + _prev (e.g. total_assets_prev); available together with the current report

name: fund_report_month
formula: month in which the current Worldscope snapshot appears in Datastream (any item changed) = first month of its fiscal year

name: fund_fye_month
formula: fiscal year end of the current snapshot
notes: see CHANGES_ws_dating.md

name: fund_available_month
formula: first month in which the snapshot is used
inputs: fund_fye_month + lag (rolling; default 4) or June after the fiscal year end (ff)

name: fund_age_months
formula: months between the current month and fund_fye_month
notes: snapshots more than max_age_months (18 rolling / 24 ff) after fiscal year end are not used

name: fund_prev_report_month
formula: report month of the snapshot used for <var>_prev

name: co2e_total_reported
formula: ENERDP023, else ENERDP024 + ENERDP025

name: co2e_total_combined
formula: co2e_total_reported, else co2e_total_estimated

name: co2e_is_estimated
formula: 1 if co2e_total_combined comes from the estimate only

name: sales_fy
formula: WC01001 of the same fiscal year (fiscal year end from WC05350)

name: co2e_intensity
formula: co2e_total_combined / (sales_fy / 1000)
unit: t CO2e per million of sales
notes: US: USD; EU: local currency (convert before comparing countries)

name: co2e_scope1_intensity
formula: co2e_scope1 / (sales_fy / 1000)
unit: t CO2e per million of sales

name: co2e_scope12_intensity
formula: (co2e_scope1 + co2e_scope2) / (sales_fy / 1000)
unit: t CO2e per million of sales

name: co2e_growth
formula: log(co2e_total_combined / co2e_total_combined of the previous fiscal year)
notes: previous fiscal year 9-15 months earlier and same source (both reported or both estimated)

name: em_fye_month
formula: fiscal year end of the emission snapshot

name: em_available_month
formula: em_fye_month + lag (default 12)
notes: Zhang (Carbon Returns Across the Globe): median lag ~10 months

name: em_age_months
formula: months between Date and em_fye_month
notes: snapshots older than 24 months after fiscal year end are not used

name: is_financial
formula: 1 if TRBC economic sector = Financials
notes: missing without TRBC classification (current, not point in time)

name: log_co2e_total_combined
formula: log(co2e_total_combined)
notes: also log_co2e_scope1, log_co2e_scope2; zeros -> missing

name: co2e_intensity_ind_adj
formula: log(co2e_intensity) - monthly median within TRBC industry group
notes: at least 5 firms per industry group and month

name: leverage
formula: total_debt / total_assets

name: invest_ta
formula: capex / total_assets

name: roe
formula: net_income / common_equity (positive equity)

name: sales_growth
formula: sales / sales_prev - 1
notes: previous report 9+ months earlier

name: vol_12m
formula: std of monthly returns t-11..t
notes: 12 consecutive months

name: ret_next
formula: return of month t+1
notes: consecutive months only
